summary: treg is a Python tools registry and proxy: one token routes agents to thousands of catalogued SEO, people-search, ads, and scraping APIs billed per call, while team-owned keys and skills stay server-side and unmetered.
question_it_answers: How can agents call SEO and enrichment APIs without buying Semrush-scale subscriptions?

claims.text: treg catalogs 2,896 endpoints across 60 providers, priced per call from about one cent.
claims.evidence: 2,896 catalogued endpoints across 60 providers — SEO and backlinks, social and trends, people and company enrichment, ads, scraping — priced per call, from a cent
claims.subject: mcp-and-agent-browsers

claims.text: Team-registered API keys always override treg's catalog keys and are never metered.
claims.evidence: Your own key always wins over treg's, and those calls are never metered.
claims.subject: mcp-and-agent-browsers

claims.text: GET treg.to/providers.json is still version 12 with 104 named BYO providers. GET treg.dev/providers.json is 404; treg.dev is not the dump host.
claims.evidence: treg.to/providers.json HTTP 200 size 23376 version 12 providers.length 104 (Google Ads … OpenWeather). treg.dev/providers.json HTTP 404 size 6888. treg.dev/ 200 599592 B.
claims.subject: mcp-and-agent-browsers
